facts.description:
View 4326 West 10th Ave V6R None rent availability including the monthly rent price and browse photos of this 2 bed, 1 bath, 935 Sq. Ft. apartment. 4326 West 10th Ave is currently on market.
4326 West 10th Avenue, at Discovery.  Available Sept 1. This 935-square foot suite combines 1950s spaciousness and elegance with a modern kitchen, bathroom and lighting. Excellent public transportation to UBC via #99 B-Line, #14.  15-minute bike ride to campus centre. Each bedroom can comfortably accommodate a queen-size bed. New tripe-glazed windows (three layers of glass) provide maximum quiet and heat insulation. Self-cleaning range with induction cooktop.  Noiseless dishwasher. Rent includes heat and hot water. Located in a very well-maintained 12-suite apartment building that has been in the same family since it was built in the 1950s. Building features include:• a laundry room with secure bicycle storage and video surveillance• security cameras covering building entrances and exterior walkways• cellphone-controlled entry system that allows you to remotely open building front door• bright interior and exterior lightingPlease note that one-year lease and tenant’s insurance are required. Please call or write Milo to arrange viewing.
